visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen displays two men pointing forward; they transition through a flash into a scene where they wear sunglasses and trendy jackets (denim and cream). (2) A young man in sunglasses walks down an outdoor urban sidewalk toward the camera, followed by four friends who cheer and wave. (3) The group enters a brightly lit eyewear retail store with modern white shelving; the man points out a display stand featuring a portrait of himself and a collaborator. (4) A montage shows three different women and one man trying on various sunglass frames in front of mirrors, smiling and gesturing with their hands to their faces. (5) The camera zooms in on a brown glasses case and a teal cleaning cloth, then focuses on a small lightning bolt logo on the side of a black sunglass frame. (6) The man stands centrally in the store, holding the glasses open to reveal printed text on the inner arm while speaking directly to the viewer with wide gestures.

(2) A male voice enters with a high-arousal, excited tone, speaking Mandarin at a fast pace. Background music continues with a driving bass line. Faint outdoor city ambience is audible. (3) A distinct 'Ding' bell SFX triggers as the scene shifts indoors. Multiple female voices are heard laughing and reacting with high pitch, overlapping the main narrator's speech. (4) Rapid-fire dialogue exchange occurs between the narrator and the group. Sound of glasses being handled creates small plastic clicks. (5) The narrator's voice becomes more focused and professional while describing product features. Fabric rustling is heard as he handles a cleaning cloth. (6) Final energetic wrap-up with the narrator's voice rising in volume. The BGM swells slightly before a hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Experience -> Product Detail -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional announcement for a collaboration between the 'dodomen' creators and the eyewear brand 'Klassic'. It combines personal vlog-style excitement with a retail store visit and detailed product showcasing to encourage viewers to purchase the co-branded sunglasses.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly mentions the brand Klassic multiple times, visits their physical store, showcases specific products, and provides a call to action for viewers to visit and buy.
